query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing challenges with particle separation in our hydrocyclone. Can you help me optimize the cut diameter by analyzing the impact of inlet velocity and density differentials?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Optimize the cut diameter of a hydrocyclone by analyzing the impact of inlet velocity and density differentials on particle separation performance.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative analysis and optimization of hydrocyclone performance
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated analysis of fluid dynamics and separation performance

clarification_questions: What is the current cut diameter and what is the desired cut diameter?
What are the particle size distribution and density of the feed material?
What are the operating conditions of the hydrocyclone (inlet flow rate, pressure)?
Are there any constraints on the operating conditions?
